LESSON: EXTENSIVE READING: LIBRARY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.7 Reading Comprehension (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building-parts of th
Topic 2.9: Extensive Reading: Library Skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Extensive Reading: Library Skills. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we make reading texts enjoyable?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify simple Arabic texts to read for enjoyment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: EXTENSIVE READING: LIBRARY SKILLS
This lesson teaches Extensive Reading: Library Skills for Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify simple Arabic texts to read for enjoyment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Extensive Reading: Library Skills using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Extensive Reading: Library Skills above.
2. Explain Extensive Reading: Library Skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Extensive Reading: Library Skills with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Extensive Reading: Library Skills important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we make reading texts enjoyable?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify simple Arabic texts to read for enjoyment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
